scope: Copy and fill during implementation; null fields and empty arrays are not evidence or permission to pass.

fieldGuide.recordKind: Set to IMPLEMENTATION_ACCEPTANCE only for a filled actual record; do not present this template as an observed result.
fieldGuide.stageId: M0 through M8. Checkpoint is null except M8-RC, M8-BETA or M8-STABLE.
fieldGuide.prerequisites: Each item: taskId or stageId, requiredProfile, observedStatus, candidate/equivalence reference and evidence record reference.
fieldGuide.candidate: Use SHA-256 of declared scopes and sanitized configuration manifests. Record non-applicability with reason and reviewer; never silently omit a required digest or hash raw guessable secrets.
fieldGuide.environments: Each item: environmentId, local/mock/sandbox/service/live profile, tool/runtime/service versions, account/program nonsecret identity, effective limits, fixture/seed, clock mode and sanitation notes.
fieldGuide.criterionResults: Each item: criterionId (for example M0-C01), environmentId, mandatory, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/STALE, expected, observed and evidenceRefs. Include every applicable criterion from acceptance-status.json.
fieldGuide.commonStandardResults: Each item: standard name, applicability with justification, result, assertions and evidenceRefs. Non-applicability cannot waive mandatory phase/profile requirements.
fieldGuide.scenarioResults: Each item: SC/T/G IDs, taskIds, profile, environmentId, mandatory, result, expected/observed assertions, iteration/seed, commandRef and evidenceRefs. Partial profile PASS does not close all of an SC/G.
fieldGuide.commands: Each item: commandId, sanitized invocation, environmentId, start/end time, exit code and log/assertion references; do not store secrets or signed download URLs.
fieldGuide.defects: Each item: defectId, severity P0-P3, mandatoryCriterionAffected, status, impact, owner, dueDate, correction and regression evidenceRefs. No open P0/P1 or failed mandatory condition can pass.
fieldGuide.externalInputs: Each item: required input, owner, affected tasks/checkpoints, availability, next action and nonsecret authority reference.
fieldGuide.review: A reviewer independent of affected implementation is mandatory before PASS, followed by an integrator decision. A technical agent review is not commercial authorization.
fieldGuide.invalidation: Preserve previous failures and superseded decisions. Each carriedEvidence item needs oldRecordRef, unchanged scopes, equivalence rationale and reviewer; changed relevant digests require reruns.
fieldGuide.observation: Required for M8-STABLE; plan/window recorded at RC before observation. Exercise all applicable J1-J10 and recovery/upgrade/recurring-worker/alert paths; idle elapsed time cannot pass.
fieldGuide.passRule: Every required predecessor and mandatory condition/profile passes on current or reviewed equivalent bytes; common standards pass, evidence is present, reviewer is independent and integrator records PASS. Missing/blocked/skipped/unexplained-flaky/stale evidence fails this rule.
